evidence: Directly refactors the logging subsystem in src/logging.cpp, src/logging.h, and src/util/log.h to use atomic bitmasks for categories.
rationale: The PR makes disabled debug and trace category checks lock-free and fully inlined to eliminate mutex overhead on hot code paths. As stated in the description, it 'reduces ShouldDebugLog and ShouldTraceLog to lock-free checks on a single atomic' to avoid locking or map lookups across threads.
